name: dmma_trmm
desc: DMMA.8x8x4 f64 TRMM (CUTLASS 32_basic_trmm op class): one warp computes the triangular matrix multiply D=alpha*A*B (A lower-triangular left-side operand, K=8 => TWO accumulated m8n8k4 atoms) via the warp-true atom; audits a triangular operand + multi-K-group accumulation. Compared to a host f64 fma-chain replica.
